notes: «علي يعني ابن الجعد»: the editor's gloss is left out; the stored name is علي.
«صاحب هذه الدار» names no one, so it is an unnamed last link; the house of عبد الله بن مسعود is the place pointed to in the scene, not a transmitter (rule 6).
The saying («سألت رسول الله …») is this unnamed man's own words, so he is the last link.
